title: using RPG Maker 2003 Gray color changes from original import

posts.author: bubblezzzzzz
posts.body: I imported a png for system and when I run the game the gray that was originally a redish gray changes to a greenish gray. This isn't really a bad thing unless you want to do pixel art that requires more precise coloring. What does rpg maker 2003 use to draw the colors on the screen? The picture included here is a picture of the import on my desktop and the other is a picture of it in game.
